title: Pausable paused()
detects: A successful call means the contract has a pause mechanism. Whoever holds the pauser role can halt transfers.
knownFalseNegative: paused() returning false only says transfers are not halted RIGHT NOW. The capability still exists, and capability is what gets scored, not the current state.

coversExamples.observed: pausable, which is expected for a regulated issuer

rationale: Pausing is both insider power and an exit blocker. It is assigned to the Control axis, with the mapping documented in METHODOLOGY.md.
